newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort off one point at 8.0.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort off one point at 8.0.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News index of consumer comfort fell one point to 8.0 in the week ended June 15 from the prior week.
The survey polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, personal finances and their willingness to spend.
Respondents' confidence in the economy fell two points to 12 from 14. Confidence in personal finances fell to 24 from 26, while the rating of buying climate held steady at -12.
Regionally, confidence was highest in the West at 15, but attitudes fell in the Midwest and Northeast.
The current poll has a margin error of plus or minus 3.5 percentage points.
